subject: Linkage Fee Ordinance Updates
overview: The committee met to consider proposed updates aligning the city's linkage fee ordinance with state law and adding an affordable housing linkage fee bucket. The committee approved minor drafting corrections and voted to report the papers out of committee to initiate the zoning amendment process.

items.title: Linkage Fee Ordinance Compliance and Affordable Housing Structure (Papers 24-056 and 24-057)
items.summary: The committee reviewed proposed updates to bring municipal linkage fees into compliance with state law and add a dedicated affordable housing linkage fee, approving minor drafting corrections before voting to report the papers out of committee.
